description: Write one receipt for an agentic order a gate has cleared. Authenticated: Authorization: Bearer <writer token>. Returns the decision_id; idempotent on decision_id.

cleared_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC; the door's clock when absent

decision_id.description: the gate's decision id (dec_<hex>); minted here when absent

gtin.description: the cleared object's identifier (a GTIN on goods rails; the ISIN or issuer identifier on a market door)

rule_version.description: the rule set and version the gate applied

name: write_receipt
